source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 115 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 115 was established by Ordinance No. 16408, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 14, 1979. Ordinance No. 16408 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 115 is established on property located at the northeast corner of Forest Lane and Creekway Drive. The size of PD 115 is approximately 3.18 acres. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-115.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development must be in accordance with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 115A). (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.105.USES. Single-family units, attached or detached, and common open areas are permitted, except that on the northernmost three lots only single-family detached units are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.106.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat as approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk. In conjunction with the submission of the subdivision plat, a legal instrument establishing a plan for permanent care and maintenance of any common area or communally-owned facility must be submitted and approved by the city attorney as to legal form and by the city plan commission as to suitability for the proposed use of the common area. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.107.DENSITY. A maximum of 11 dwelling units is permitted. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-115.108.STREETS AND PAVING.
(a)All driveways, entrances, and dedicated streets must be constructed to the requirements of the department of public works and transportation and other departments of the city. No permanent building or structures may be placed on the “Easement for Street Purposes.”
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.109.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts as specified in Chapter 41, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.110.SETBACKS. All buildings must be set back as indicated on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.111.HEIGHT. All residential structures may not exceed two stories in height, as that term is defined in the comprehensive zoning ordinance, except on the northern-most three lots where the maximum height is one story, as that term is defined in the comprehensive zoning ordinance. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.112.COVERAGE. Maximum percent of lot area which may be covered by the main building and all accessory buildings for residential uses may not exceed 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.113.PARKING. Parking must be provided at the ratio of three spaces per residential unit, and the required spaces may be placed in tandem. In no instance may a parking space violate a platted building line. All enclosed parking spaces located so as to face upon or be entered directly from a street or alley may be located not nearer than 20 feet from the property line. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.114.SCREENING. A brick fence not less than six feet in height must be erected along the northern boundary of this PD and located three feet south of and parallel to the north property line. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-115.115.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Development and utilization of this Property must be in compliance with all other applicable codes and regulations of the city.
(b)The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the comprehensive general zoning ordinance of the city and the Dallas Building Code. (Ord. Nos. 16408; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-115.116.ZONING MAP. PD 115 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25508)
